checklist.label: Water body
checklist.question: Is a lake, pond or river visible, or described in the voice note?

checklist.label: Glacial setting
checklist.question: Is this a glacial setting, with glacier ice or bare moraine ridges in view? Milky or turquoise water alone is not enough: rivers carry that colour far from any glacier.

checklist.label: Glacier touches water
checklist.question: Does glacier ice touch the water, or end very close to it?
checklist.source: Rounce et al. 2016, HESS 20:3455 (mother glacier within 600 m)

checklist.label: Icebergs or calving
checklist.question: Are there icebergs on the water, or ice cliffs breaking into it?

checklist.label: Steep slopes or hanging ice above
checklist.question: Do steep rock walls or hanging ice rise directly from the lake shore, close enough for falling rock or ice to reach the water? Distant mountains in the background do not count.
checklist.source: Fujita et al. 2013, NHESS 13:1827; Rounce et al. 2016, HESS 20:3455

checklist.label: Fresh rockfall scars above
checklist.question: Are there fresh rockfall or landslide scars on the slopes directly above the lake?

checklist.label: Dam or outlet in view
checklist.question: Can you see the end of the lake where water flows out, and the ridge or dam at that end?

checklist.label: Moraine dam
checklist.question: Is the water held back by a ridge of loose rock and debris (a moraine dam) rather than solid bedrock?

checklist.label: Low freeboard
checklist.question: Does the top of the dam sit only a little above the water level?

checklist.label: Steep dam face
checklist.question: Is the downstream (outer) face of the dam steep?
checklist.source: Lv et al. 1999 (moderate confidence; not independently verified)

checklist.label: Seepage or breach
checklist.question: Is water seeping out through the dam face, or is there a breach channel cut through it?

checklist.label: Downstream in view
checklist.question: Can you see the land below the lake's outlet, where water flowing out of the lake would go?

checklist.label: People or structures downstream
checklist.question: Are trails, houses, bridges or fields visible downstream of the water?
